name: ElevenLabs
description: Read-only ElevenLabs access: the account's subscription tier and remaining character quota, the voice and model catalogues, and past generation history. Text-to-speech (POST /v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}) spends the account's character quota and returns raw audio bytes rather than JSON, so it is modelled write:true and HITL-gated and never fired here; every read below is a zero-spend authed GET.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Get the ElevenLabs account behind this API key: subscription tier and remaining character quota (used and limit). The cheap balance read and the spec's auth-proving test call

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List voices available to this account, from ElevenLabs's shared library and any cloned voices, with id, name and category

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the text-to-speech models available on this account, with id, name and supported languages

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: List past generations (text-to-speech, dubbing, etc) on this account, most recent first, with the voice used and generation date

page_size.description: Max history items to return (default 100, max 1000)

tools.name: text_to_speech
tools.description: Generate speech audio from text using a specific voice. This spends the account's character quota and returns raw audio bytes (not JSON), so it is HITL-gated and never fired by the shape-proof harness (write:true means blind proof always SKIPs it; a real credential would also need --include-writes)

voice_id.description: ElevenLabs voice id to speak with, from list_voices

model_id.description: Optional model id to use, from list_models (API default: eleven_multilingual_v2)

needs_review: NO LIVE CREDENTIAL AT AUTHORING TIME: this spec is shape-proved blind only. LIVE_PROVEN should be clean and free once a real key is supplied: /v1/user, /v1/voices, /v1/models and /v1/history are all zero-spend authed GETs per the build plan.

text_to_speech deliberately carries no response block: the real 2xx response body is raw audio bytes (audio/mpeg), not JSON, so there is nothing to pick even if this tool were ever fired; it is documented write:true and HITL-gated specifically because a JSON pick would be dishonest here.

REPLACES A SCAFFOLD STUB: an earlier connector-scaffold.mjs pass generated services/collector/lib/connectors/specs/drafts/elevenlabs.connector.json (tools: [], never registered — drafts/ is not read by registry.js) from the vault type alone. That stub had zero tools to carry forward; nothing was dropped by building this version from scratch in the live specs/ directory instead.

Vault credentialType 'elevenlabs' ALREADY EXISTED in integrationTypeRegistry.js (field api_key, testEndpoint https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/user, header xi-api-key) and was reused as-is; no new registration added, no integrationTestDepth count change for this connector.

Dubbing (POST /v1/dubbing, async submit-then-poll like fal/Replicate) is explicitly out of scope per the build plan's Phase A/B split: this connector covers the synchronous voice/model/quota/history reads and the (never-fired) TTS write only; dubbing is a Phase-B addition.
